M1_never_sends_if_none_match._note: The header stops going out: every read is a full 200 and the primary quota is spent, which is the whole point of the requirement.

M2_never_remembers_an_etag._note: Nothing is stored, so nothing can ever be validated.
M2_never_remembers_an_etag.from:
const etag = resp.headers?.("etag");
  if (typeof etag !== "string" || etag.length === 0) return;
M2_never_remembers_an_etag.to:
const etag = resp.headers?.("etag");
  if (typeof etag === "string") return;

M3_write_is_fire_and_forget._note: Restores a defect the axes caught during implementation: with the store write un-awaited, two reads of the same endpoint with no intervening yield leave the SECOND one unconditional — the validator exists but nobody can see it yet.

M4_304_handed_on_as_empty_success._note: 304, чьё тело больше не помнится, отдаётся как есть вместо перечитывания: вызывающий получил бы ПУСТОЙ успех, что хуже лишнего запроса. ⛤ Якорь сжат до одной строки: прежняя редакция захватывала хвост с `rememberFrom(...)`, а починка гонки (M3) добавила туда `await` ⇒ count стал 0. Строка `return storeFresh(...)` с шестью пробелами уникальна (у строки 284 отступ 4).

M5_accept_not_modified_not_requested._note: The transport is not told to accept a 304, so it throws on one — the contract says non-2xx throws unless the caller opted in.

M6_key_ignores_the_url._note: One validator for every endpoint: a ref's ETag would be sent for a tree, and repositories would share entries.

M7_writes_made_conditional._note: Drops the GET gate — a POST would be given an If-None-Match.

M8_unbounded_store._note: The entry ceiling stops being enforced.

M9_oversized_bodies_remembered._note: A huge body is stored anyway, so the store is bounded by nothing but entry count.

M10_corrupt_store_is_fatal._note: Removes the tolerant read: an unparseable store would abort instead of degrading to unconditional reads.
M10_corrupt_store_is_fatal.from:
const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
      if (parsed === null || typeof parsed !== "object") return {};
M10_corrupt_store_is_fatal.to:
const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
      if (parsed === null) return {};
